passages.substance: Perform qualitative/quantitative experiments while respecting safety/environment, describe, record and evaluate; name and handle lab equipment appropriately.

Experimentally investigate and describe properties; infer hazards from pictograms; plan and perform separation experiment. Basic handling and general safety are prerequisites to these practical demands.

Plan/perform and record reactions; perform and describe selected gas/ion/functional-group detections; use indicators. Basic lab and contextual safety are appropriate background, without replacing detection-specific knowledge or precautions.

acquisition.reason: Complete experiment profile demands actual taring/weighing, volume reading, filtering/decanting/bulb transfer and an original observation log. The two linked cases use supervised water/salt/sand/gravel; supplied practice data are explicitly not observed learner work. This fits basic lab handling and organized documentation; role change must not alter this profile.

Complete DE/EN profile demands context-sensitive actual preparation at a harmless supervised model station and a fresh splash-response decision. It distinguishes application from rote recitation and does not treat general lab rules as full hazardous-substance qualification. No new safety approval or real-learner observation asserted.

appropriateExistingChildPriors.reason: Basic apparatus handling, recording and general safety fit experimental investigation of properties in BW 3.2.1.1; does not establish that every purely descriptive act inherently needs a lab performance.

Handling vessels, recording observations and general safety are appropriate foundations before performing gas detections; they do not substitute for specific hydrogen/oxygen/carbon-dioxide detection procedures or hazard controls.

Basic manipulations, labeling, observation logs and safe contextual conduct are appropriate before experimental ion testing. This narrow review does not reapprove the entire salt-composition or product-checking scope from a single BW passage.
